body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not limit all family co-payments to seven percent or less of family income, as required by 98.45(l)(3). (Plan Question 3.1.1a). Please note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for this requirement through March 31, 2026. Overall Target Completion Date: 05/19/2025 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 The Department is in process of building an integrated Child Care Management System, Baxter, which will help to manage provider payments amongst other interactions for families and providers on the CCAP program. Limiting co- payments to seven percent or less for all eligible families at 85% and below State Median Income (SMI) is built into this system and will roll out when this system goes live. 05/19/2025 2 CCAP rules are being updated to reflect a cap at 7% or less of family income for those eligible for CCDF funds at 85% or less of SMI. 05/19/2025

body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not pay all provider types prospectively or alternatively does not demonstrate that it is not a generally-accepted practice for all provider types, as required by 98.45(m)(1). (Plan Question 4.4.1a). Please note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for this requirement through March 31, 2026. • The Lead Agency does not pay providers based on enrollment or alternatively does not provide justification that this is impracticable or is not a generally-accepted practice, as required by 98.45(m)(2). (Plan Question 4.4.1b). Please note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for this requirement through March 31, 2026. Overall Target Completion Date: 05/19/2025 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 The Department is in process of building an integrated Child Care Management System, Baxter, which will help to manage provider payments and will be used to pay providers prospectively and by enrollment once it goes live. 05/19/2025 2 Change our State CCAP rules to include prospective payment policies. 05/19/2025 3 Change our State CCAP rules to include paying by enrollment rather than attendance. 05/19/2025 4 Change internal protocols and procedures and train staff accordingly to align with a smooth transition to these two new payment practices. 05/19/2025

body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not provide grants or contracts for direct services for infants and toddlers, for children in underserved geographic areas, and for children with disabilities, as required by 98.30(b)(1). (Plan Questions 4.1.1c and 4.5.1i). Please note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for this requirement through March 31, 2026. Overall Target Completion Date: 03/31/2026 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 Research and review areas of the State that fall under geographically underserved areas using the latest Gap Analysis as well as other demographic information. 02/28/2025 2 Create an Access and Stabilization Strategy for how we use Grants and Contracts according to the above researched information and in relationship to serving infants and toddlers as well 06/30/2025 as children with disabilities. This includes identifying potential programs to partner with in the administration of grants and contracts. 3 Create MOUs to utilize with programs and get them approved by State administrators. 09/30/2025 4 Fully execute and implement the MOUs for grants and contracts within the State 03/31/2026
